title: Remove dashboard widgets you do not use

widgets.description: Meta box ids to take off the dashboard. The list you choose from is the one the scan actually found on your dashboard.

description: Stops the dashboard widgets you name from being registered. Nothing is uninstalled and no data is touched: the widget simply is not built on the dashboard, and comes back the moment you unselect this.
breaks: A widget you removed is not on the dashboard, including any notice a plugin only shows there
